items.title: Asset freshness with fresh/stale badge and automatic watchdog
items.summary: The `// freshness <window>` annotation on pipeline scripts now shows a live fresh/stale verdict on the pipeline graph, emerald when the last successful run completed within the window and amber when it is stale or has never run. On Enterprise Edition, a freshness watchdog re-runs stale unpartitioned scripts automatically with exponential backoff capped at the window; watchdog runs skip the downstream cascade, are attributed to pseudo-user freshness-<path> with the new freshness trigger kind, and can be disabled instance-wide with DISABLE_FRESHNESS_WATCHDOG.
